title: End-of-Sale & End-of-Life Notice for Zscaler Office365Mon

blocks.text: Zscaler is announcing the End-of-Sale (EOS) and End-of-Life (EOL) dates for Zscaler Office365Mon (Office 365 Monitoring). To learn more, see https://www.office365mon.com/.
As of October 20, 2022, subscriptions for Office365Mon will not be available for purchase. The Office365Mon service and all existing tenants will continue to be supported until the EOL date.

If you are using Office365Mon, you should consider a migration plan to Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) for Microsoft 365—the multi-tenant, cloud-based monitoring platform that covers monitoring of Microsoft 365 with integration for Call Quality Monitoring, Microsoft Teams web app, Microsoft OneDrive, Microsoft SharePoint, and Microsoft Outlook monitoring.
Contact Zscaler Support to devise a migration plan.
To learn more about Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX), see https://www.zscaler.com/products/zscaler-digital-experience. If you have additional questions, contact Zscaler Support.
